components.name: MessageBubbleGroup
components.doc: A run of bubbles from one sender. It spaces them tightly and gives each its place, so only the last one carries the tail.

types.name: MessageBubbleProps
types.doc: One chat bubble. The person's bubbles sit on the right in the accent; the assistant's sit on the left on a quiet surface. Consecutive bubbles from one sender group: inner corners tighten and only the last one keeps the tail.

members.name: from
members.doc: Who wrote it. Decides the side, the color and where the tail points.

members.name: children
members.doc: The message. Text wraps; links, emphasis and inline code are fine.

members.name: position
members.doc: Place inside a run of bubbles from the same sender. `MessageBubbleGroup` sets it for you.

members.name: timestamp
members.doc: Time shown under the bubble, already formatted (for example "9:41").

members.name: status
members.doc: Delivery state shown as ticks after the timestamp. Each new tick draws itself in.

members.name: typing
members.doc: Shows three bouncing dots instead of the content while the other side is writing.

members.name: tail
members.doc: Draws the tail on a single or last bubble.

members.name: animateIn
members.doc: Pops the bubble in from its tail corner when it mounts. Turn it off for history that is already there.

members.name: author
members.doc: Name read by screen readers before the message. Defaults to "You" or "Assistant".

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the row element.

members.name: from
members.doc: Sender of every bubble in the group.

members.name: children
members.doc: `MessageBubble` elements, as direct children. Each one gets its `from` and `position` from the group.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the group, for example "Messages from Dana".

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class for the group element.
